plan: Since this is a single round with no history, the optimal strategy involves bidding slightly less than my value to maximize profit if I win. Bidding exactly my value risks zero profit if I win, while bidding too low risks losing. Given my value is $6, I will bid slightly less to ensure I have a chance to win without overpaying.

Given my value of $40, I should bid slightly below it to maximize profit while still having a good chance of winning. Rational bidders will bid below their values to avoid negative profit. Bidding $39.9 ensures I win if others bid similarly rationally below their values. This bid maximizes my chance of profit while staying competitive.

Given my value of $28, I should bid slightly below this to maximize potential profit while remaining competitive. A rational strategy involves bidding less than my value to ensure a positive profit if I win. I will bid $27.9, slightly below my value, to outbid others who might also bid just below their value, while ensuring I don't overpay and risk a loss.
